title: Mini-Batch Risk-Averse Deep Q-Learning: A Robot Navigation Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.07998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the control of Markov decision processes in which the quality of a policy is evaluated by a dynamic, time-consistent Markov risk measure rather than by an expected discounted cost. The main obstacle to combining such measures with reinforcement learning is that a transition risk mapping depends on the transition kernel in a nonlinear way, and therefore cannot be estimated from a single observed transition. We remove this obstacle by employing mini-batch transition risk mappings: the mapping is applied to the empirical measure of $N$ independent next-state samples, and the result is averaged. The resulting mapping is again coherent. However, as an expected value of a function of $N$ next-state values, it admits an unbiased one-sample estimator.   We embed this mapping into a double deep Q-network, analyze the two sources of estimation bias that arise, and obtain a risk-averse Q-learning method applicable to state spaces far beyon

translated_title: 小批量风险厌恶深度Q学习：机器人导航案例研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了马尔可夫决策过程的控制问题，其中策略的质量由动态的、时间一致的马尔可夫风险度量来评估，而非由期望折现成本来评估。将此类度量与强化学习相结合的主要障碍在于，转移风险映射以非线性方式依赖于转移核，因此无法从单个观测到的转移中进行估计。我们通过采用小批量转移风险映射来消除这一障碍：将该映射应用于N个独立下一状态样本的经验测度，然后对结果取平均。所得映射仍然是连贯的。然而，作为N个下一状态值的函数的期望值，它允许无偏的单样本估计器。我们将该映射嵌入到双重深度Q网络中，分析了由此产生的两种估计偏差来源，并获得了一种适用于远超（传统表格设置）状态空间的风险厌恶Q学习方法。
tldr: 提出小批量转移风险映射方法，克服了动态时间一致马尔可夫风险度量无法从单次转移估计的障碍，实现了可扩展到连续状态空间的风险厌恶深度Q学习，并以机器人导航作为案例验证。
en_tdlr: Proposes mini-batch transition risk mappings to overcome the obstacle that dynamic time-consistent Markov risk measures cannot be estimated from a single transition, yielding a risk-averse double deep Q-learning method scalable to large state spaces, validated through a robot navigation case study.
